command.wildcraft.temperature.status: Environment %s; index %s (not Celsius); biome %s / weather %s / water %s / heat %s; reads %s / rays %s
energy.wildcraft.battery_help: Charge beside a fixed redstone block
energy.wildcraft.screen.help.0: Insert a finite battery. An empty slot is different from a battery with no charge.
energy.wildcraft.screen.help.1: Place a fixed redstone block beside the charger, on any of its six adjacent sides. Held blocks and redstone signals do not supply energy.
energy.wildcraft.screen.help.2: Receiving supply from an adjacent redstone block. The number shows the battery’s current charge.
energy.wildcraft.screen.help.3: The battery holds 1000 units and is ready to use. A full battery stays full without a source.
energy.wildcraft.screen.help.4: A redstone source is present. Waiting for its shared supply; the battery keeps its existing charge.
fabrication.wildcraft.screen.help.0: At least 4 copper ingots and 2 redstone, no active job, and an empty output slot. Ready to make.
fabrication.wildcraft.screen.help.1: Each batch needs 4 copper ingots and 2 redstone. Add the missing material. Redstone is consumed; no external power source is required.
fabrication.wildcraft.screen.help.2: Runs for 100 loaded world ticks. Closing the menu does not cancel. Pausing, going offline or unloading does not add progress. The new result stays hidden until transfer.
fabrication.wildcraft.screen.help.3: This batch is complete, waiting for a free output slot. The visible existing item is not the pending result. Remove it so the server can transfer the committed result without rerolling.
fabrication.wildcraft.screen.help.4: The finished item is in the actual output slot. Collect it to make another batch if materials suffice. A full inventory keeps the original output; no extra ground reward is issued.
focus.wildcraft.help.fov: Optional slight FOV reduction; off by default.
focus.wildcraft.help.pattern: Static contour lines at the periphery only.
focus.wildcraft.help.pulse: Optional gentle low-stamina pulse; off by default.
focus.wildcraft.help.reticle: Focus reticle; low stamina changes both colour and ticks.
focus.wildcraft.help.vignette: Gently shades the edges, keeping the aiming centre clear.
focus.wildcraft.settings.hint: Presentation only; skill, stamina and environment readings stay active
fuse.wildcraft.controls: Host in main hand / material offhand · %s to fuse · sneak + key to split
fuse.wildcraft.kind.0: Generic: melee / arrow +1; shield pushes nearby attacker
fuse.wildcraft.kind.1: Rock: melee / arrow +2; shield pushes nearby attacker
fuse.wildcraft.kind.2: Metal: melee / arrow +3; shield pushes nearby attacker
fuse.wildcraft.kind.3: Flame: +1; hit / full block ignites for 3 seconds
fuse.wildcraft.kind.4: Ice: +1; hit / full block slows for 3 seconds
fuse.wildcraft.kind.5: Elastic: +1; hit / full block adds knockback
fuse.wildcraft.kind.6: Material unavailable: effects and splitting disabled; data retained
fuse.wildcraft.refused: Check hands, material limits and free inventory space
fuse.wildcraft.split_done: Split; material keeps its remaining uses
key.wildcraft.climb: Hold to climb / release to let go
machine.wildcraft.aim: Move closer and aim at a visible machine node
machine.wildcraft.body_failed: Switch off, remove parts, leave the seat and make inventory room
machine.wildcraft.drive_hint: W/S drive · A/D steer · %s toggle · sneak to dismount
machine.wildcraft.empty_hand: Use a part or empty hand as shown
machine.wildcraft.ground_hint: Empty hand: right-click to ride · sneak-click node/panel to remove/toggle · sneak-attack empty body to recover
machine.wildcraft.help.buoyancy: Passive water buoyancy; supports up to 1.75 load per device
machine.wildcraft.help.rocket: One-shot fuel; keeps burning after power off and cannot be removed while lit
machine.wildcraft.help.spent_rocket: No thrust; cannot install; craft to recover one copper ingot
machine.wildcraft.help.spring: Ground launch costs 20 per spring; power off, land and cool down to rearm
machine.wildcraft.help.stabilizer: Costs 2 per tick; limits side drift and smooths steering, without cancelling gravity
machine.wildcraft.help.wheel: Powered ground drive; ride with W/S and steer with A/D
machine.wildcraft.help.wing: Passive glide requires speed; greater load descends faster
machine.wildcraft.install_failed: Aim at an empty node; one battery per machine
machine.wildcraft.owner: Only its creator can modify this machine
machine.wildcraft.recover_failed: Aim at an installed node and make inventory room
machine.wildcraft.riding: Riding: A/D steer, machine key toggles power, sneak to dismount
machine.wildcraft.spent_part: A spent rocket cannot be installed
machine.wildcraft.stop_first: Switch off before installing or removing parts
meal.wildcraft.help.1: Slows powder-snow freezing; does not prevent freezing damage
meal.wildcraft.help.2: Softens heat tint; no fire or lava protection
meal.wildcraft.help.3: Faster eligible stamina recovery; capacity unchanged
temperature.wildcraft.help.tint: Subtle warm/cold edges; suppressed during focus. Readout remains when disabled.
